organic_results.title: PIB Fact Check: Government is NOT giving free ₹719 recharge to users
organic_results.snippet: A message circulating on WhatsApp claims the Government of India is offering free mobile recharge to all users. This claim is fake. It is a phishing link designed to harvest personal data.

organic_results.title: Free recharge in PM scheme? Viral WhatsApp message is a phishing scam
organic_results.snippet: BOOM found the link leads to a fraudulent site that spreads itself through WhatsApp groups. No such government scheme exists.
